parts:
You could keep it warm while also clarifying what your business actually does:

> Haha, I don't think I've done a great job explaining what we're building. 😊
>
> We're actually a growth partner for med spa owners, not just a marketing agency. Marketing is only one piece of what we do.
>
> Our process starts with a Revenue Leak Audit to identify where a practice is losing money. Then we build a customized Market Blueprint, implement patient acquisition systems (Meta ads, reactivation, referrals, etc.), optimize their sales and consultation process, and improve retention so they generate more revenue from the patients they already have.
>
> So yes, we absolutely run conversion campaigns, but only after we've made sure the rest of the business is set up to convert and retain those leads. Otherwise, it's easy to spend a lot on ads without seeing a return. That's why so many people feel like Facebook ads don't work, when in reality it's usually everything that happens before and after the click.
>
> We're trying to build predictable, sustainable growth, not just generate more leads. That's the difference. 😊

citation.reason: You’re a med-spa growth partner with a Revenue Leak Audit process.
